entities.name: Kodaira
entities.description: Village on the Towabara Plains of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which nezumi attacked Kodaira.

entities.name: Captain Matsuda
entities.description: Guard outpost captain who sheltered villagers and was arrested for it.

entities.name: Shiro
entities.description: Messenger who brought word to General Takeno.

entities.name: Munetsugu Takeno
entities.description: General who rode to Kodaira and killed the nezumi.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: Place to which dispatches were sent for help.

events.summary: During the Kami War, nezumi attacked Kodaira and Captain Matsuda let the villagers into the garrison to protect them.
events.quote: Captain Matsuda of the guard outpost let the villagers inside the garrison to prevent them from being killed by the raiders

events.summary: Shiro, the messenger, arrived to bring word to General Munetsugu Takeno.
events.quote: the messenger Shiro arrived to bring word to General Munetsugu Takeno

events.summary: Takeno rode to Kodaira with a contingent and killed the offending nezumi.
events.quote: Takeno rode to Kodaira with a contingent and killed the offending nezumi

events.summary: Takeno arrested Captain Matsuda for breaking the law by allowing villagers onto military grounds.
events.quote: then arrested Captain Matsuda for breaking the law
